name: context-guard
description: Per-session context-window observability. A statusline wrapper writes each session's context_window fields to a snapshot file; a resolver classifies usage into smart, acceptable, and dumb zones from zones.json. Hooks report each move into a worse zone once: the continuation menu to the operator, and only the zone to the model, noting a zone is not a decay signal. Optional blocking mode gates new mutating work in the dumb zone, except handoffs. A PostCompact hook leaves a marker.

context_guard_hooks_enabled.title: Zone and compaction hooks
context_guard_hooks_enabled.description: Runs the zone-crossing injection, blocking gate, and PostCompact marker hooks. On by default; off, every one of them exits without acting.

zone_hook_mode.title: Zone hook mode
zone_hook_mode.description: advisory (default) injects guidance only; blocking also denies new Write, Edit, NotebookEdit, Agent, and Workflow calls on a fresh dumb-zone snapshot past the grace budget. Handoff-path writes, reads, Bash, and Skill stay allowed, and an unknown zone fails open.

zone_gate_grace_calls.title: Blocking-gate grace budget (calls)
zone_gate_grace_calls.description: Blocking mode only: matched tool calls allowed after the session first resolves dumb, before the gate denies. Default 20; 0 denies the first matched call.
